originality.rationale: The original paper already establishes n>=p sufficiency, the Fourier filter, and the generic fixed-order variance expression; these are explicitly acknowledged. The assessed claim adds a sharp all-phase necessity with exact coefficients under the same bounded local-analytic assumptions and an evaluated sharp exponential growing-order sampling law. Literature inspections found no equivalent joint claim, while classical identities, implicit reductions, and inaccessible full sources remain residual risks.
residual_risks: The finite-p exact variance formula may be obtainable as a direct corollary of general published Hermite Gaussian-moment identities; only its joint sharp resource interpretation and growing-order scale are assessed.
